title: Ablation: Piece-square evaluation
description: The full improved engine against the same engine with only one thing changed: with the original (material + centre) evaluation. Both get 50 ms per move, so a feature that costs time but does not pay for itself shows up as a negative result. A positive Elo means the feature helps.
hypothesis: Piece-square evaluation helps: the full engine scores above 50%.

baseline.name: With the original (material + centre) evaluation, 50 ms
